task_type: authenticated administration reporting and supplier integration
requested_outcome: Turn the existing aggregate BizOnline conversion report into a complete authorized operations dashboard that shows Maskyoo calls, WhatsApp contacts, matched Biz orders, revenue, world and business breakdowns, and date-range filtering without confusing clicks with completed outcomes.
natural_destination: The authenticated VII business-performance administration surface and its private server API.
authorization_boundary: Local implementation, tests and a frozen preview candidate are authorized. Production publication, real customer contact, supplier writes, bookings, payments and destructive data changes require separate explicit authorization.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request is about trustworthy calls, messages, orders and revenue.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every metric must name its source, formula, period, timezone, uniqueness and intent-versus-outcome meaning.

lesson_bundle.reason: The result is a daily operational administration product.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Filters, drill-down, loading, failure, reload, export and authorization must work at the natural destination.

lesson_bundle.reason: A partial aggregate view would be rejected as incomplete.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The full journey from supplier contact through matched order and grouped totals requires evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: Every filter, row and drill-down promises an action.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Visible controls need real loading, success, empty, error and disabled behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: VII worlds and BizOnline supplier identities have project-specific semantics.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Use the documented vacations, events and rooms conversion contracts and preserve unsupported-world truthfulness.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The dashboard still shows only totals and Adir cannot inspect the actual Maskyoo phone that did or did not convert.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add a protected minimized contact drill-down with phone, call state, duration, first matched order, delay and later order IDs.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A selected business returns and renders each supplier contact with explicit converted and not-converted states.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A click is counted as a call, WhatsApp conversation or order.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep VII click metrics separate from supplier contacts and Biz orders, with explicit labels and formulas.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Dashboard cards and tables distinguish click, contact, converted contact, distinct order and revenue.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The totals include only businesses that happened to have VII activity rows.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Merge the complete public catalog inventory into the report before analytics and booking facts.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Supported catalog businesses remain selectable even with zero local VII activity.

predicted_rejections.rejection: All-business loading overloads BizOnline or repeats hundreds of calls on every visit.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep supplier requests bounded, user-controlled and progressively accumulated; never issue unbounded fan-out.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Batch size is capped, cancellation works, progress is visible and previous results remain usable on a partial failure.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Raw upstream data or the supplier token leaks to an unauthorized browser.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Call BizOnline server-to-server, require an authorized admin session, validate the schema and return only the minimized fields required by the report.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Anonymous calls return 403 and responses never include token, e-mail or free-text message fields.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Date and world filters change the screen but not the data and export.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use one filter contract for API queries, totals, breakdowns, detail and CSV.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Today, month and custom from/till changes produce matching server requests, visible totals and exports.

affected_family: Biz orders, revenue and conversion delay
VII phone, WhatsApp and booking intent metrics
date, world, business and source filters
loading, partial, empty, failure, reload and export states

sources.label: Supplier conversion response and matching contract

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the adapter validates and minimizes detailed contacts and the protected API returns a fixture, before the dashboard redesign.
checks: Maskyoo answered and unanswered calls validate
matched and unmatched orders remain distinct

attack_questions: Can two contacts that lead to one order inflate revenue?
Can an unmatched click appear as a call or message?
Can a malformed supplier contact or order poison the whole report?
Can an unauthorized user retrieve phone-level rows?
Can a stopped or partially failed batch erase already loaded truthful totals?
Do today, month and custom periods agree between cards, breakdowns, detail and CSV?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Authenticated preview screenshots and API probes for aggregate, source and contact-level views.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused adapter/API/UI tests, full repository regression and desktop/mobile administration inspection.

effectiveness.baseline: The current report validates and displays aggregate supplier summaries but discards contacts[], selects only businesses present in local VII activity rows, and has no phone-level Maskyoo-to-order investigation table.
effectiveness.target: One truthful operations dashboard exposes period and world totals plus authorized phone-level evidence without unbounded supplier fan-out or PII leakage.
